summary: Reconstructed the figure as a trapezoid ABCD. CV found four solid segments and bound labels A (top-left), B (bottom-left), C (bottom-right), D (top-right) with no unmatched labels. No circles or right-angle marks were detected. TikZ v1 compiles, is critic-scored 0.9, and is the best version. Vertices and labels match the original. v2 (thin 0.6pt strokes) was scored 0.85 and the critic's stroke-weight verdict flipped between versions, so I kept v1.
